newsitem.title: USA: Camdessus has no doubt Fed rate rise on horizon.
newsitem.headline: Camdessus has no doubt Fed rate rise on horizon.

text.p: International Monetary Fund Managing Director Michel Camdessus said on Tuesday he has no doubt that the U.S. Federal Reserve will have to hike rates in the future to temper inflation.
"I have no doubt that some time down the road they'll have to continue with progressive rate increases to keep inflation in check," Camdessus told reporters at a briefing.
He described the Federal Reserve's policy as "outstanding and successful" in maintaining the current expansionary phase of the U.S. economy.
Although the Fed did not pursue an increase in rates at its last Open Market Committee meeting, Camdessus said: "I believe it has been successful so far, and more increases will have to be adopted."
Camdessus was speaking to reporters at a briefing in Los Angeles ahead of a speech to the Los Angeles World Affairs Council.
